lines.en: I walk slowly on short legs

lines.zh: 我的象鼻垂着，扫过草尖
lines.en: My trunk hangs low, sweeping the grass tips
My steps are deliberate and steady
I take the gentle line up the slope
My ears flap once

lines.zh: 我在河滩上走，脚印很深
lines.en: My prints sink deep in the river gravel
I go around a low palm

lines.zh: 我的象牙碰到石头，响了一下
lines.en: My tusk knocks a stone and rings
I head for water
My trunk curls up a tuft of grass

lines.zh: 河滩上每一步都陷下去。
lines.en: Each step sinks deep into the riverbank.
I stop, then take another step
My steps pack the path down
I dip my trunk tip into the ditch
I follow an old track on the island

lines.zh: 我这一走，草丛都合不上
lines.en: The grass doesn't close behind me

lines.zh: 我靠着岩壁走，遮一点风
lines.en: I walk by the cliff to block the wind
I check the ground before each step
I stand and my trunk tests the air
I swing my trunk over my back
My ears fan slowly
I'm chewing a tough stalk
I raise my head toward the sea

lines.zh: 我脚下的土被我压实了
lines.en: The soil is packed under me
I shake my head twice
The wind off the sea is briny
I hum low through my trunk
I rub a foreleg with my trunk
I stand still in the shade
There's a flock of small birds nearby
I blink slowly

lines.zh: 我把重心从这条腿换到那条
lines.en: I shift my weight from leg to leg

lines.zh: 我很小，可我仍是一头象
lines.en: I'm small, but an elephant still
I wait here for the wind to drop
You're a little taller than me
I lift my trunk and sniff
You're not from here
I blink slowly, almost a nod.
Step back and I'll go on grazing

lines.zh: 我的象牙不长，可我不小
lines.en: My tusks are short, but I'm not small
I take half a step toward you
Don't stand right in front of me
We're about the same size

lines.zh: 你手上那东西我不认识
lines.en: I don't know what's in your hand
I lower my trunk
I plan to move on

lines.zh: 我退了两步，鼻子卷起来
lines.en: I take two steps back, trunk curling
I rumble once, drawn out
I spread my ears wide
I twist my head to see the wound
I paw at the dirt with a forefoot
I shake my trunk
I stand and hold steady
My trunk starts to huff
I turn on my short legs
I don't intend to run at all
Got grass in your hand
That smells rather good
My trunk has reached out

lines.zh: 你手再低一点，我够得着。
lines.en: Lower your hand a bit and I can reach.
That's not a mouthful
I've eaten, yet I want more
Set the grass down and step back two paces
This tastes a little of the sea
I chew very slowly
I won't snatch; I can reach
One more handful will do
My trunk is nearly on you
Don't pull your hand back
I never bite people
These leaves are a bit salty
I eat contentedly

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，我不太动
lines.en: You hit me and I hardly shift
My leg is thicker than your waist
My short legs slip and flatten the grass.
You brush past my legs
My trunk touches your shoulder
We collide and the ground answers

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，耳朵拍到你
lines.en: I shake my head and my ear hits you
I'm the smallest elephant of this island.

lines.zh: 你的护甲磕在我的象牙上
lines.en: Your armor knocks my tusk
That was nothing

lines.zh: 山坡那边有一头也朝这边来
lines.en: One from the hillside is coming this way
Our trunks touch
It's a little shorter than me
We walk into the water together
We spray each other with our trunks
It lies down in the sand
I stand beside it
We listen to the sea together

lines.zh: 这一片草地上以后有两头
lines.en: Two of us on this meadow now
Neither of us is in a hurry

lines.zh: 鼻子一收，草束就到嘴边。
lines.en: One curl of my trunk brings the grass to my mouth.
It's heavier than it looks
I raise it to my mouth and sniff
I can't eat this at all
Too small; I nudge it aside.
It slips off my trunk

lines.zh: 我踩了一下，它陷进土里
lines.en: I step on it and it sinks in
I leave it by the path
It carries the mark of my trunk
I swing my trunk and move on
You're too close; I raise my trunk
I let out a low rumble

lines.zh: 我前脚在地上蹭了两下
lines.en: I scrape the ground with a forefoot

lines.zh: 我一转头，象牙就对准你。
lines.en: As I turn, my tusks line up with you.

lines.zh: 西西里的矮象，一步不让。
lines.en: A Sicilian dwarf elephant gives no ground.
I grind over to it, step by step
The dwarf elephant's ears flare open.
Don't stand at my flank
I only want you to leave
My ears have spread
I walk at you, not fast

lines.zh: 我的鼻子抬着，随时能甩
lines.en: My trunk is up, ready to swing
The pass is narrow; you can't squeeze past.

lines.zh: 我一步一步把距离压短
lines.en: I shorten the distance step by step
My trunk swings out in a half circle.
I rumble low in my throat
I've seen all your movements
I've no call to race anyone
I rumble once more, low
I've trodden a line through the grass
My trunk swings across
It knocks you off balance
I rear a forefoot and bring it down
The ground gives way
I shoulder into you
My tusk rakes your side

lines.zh: 这一下打空了，草被踩平
lines.en: I miss and flatten the grass
I throw my head and the trunk follows
You fall back two steps and I check myself
I don't follow up

lines.zh: 山坡上出现一个矮胖的影子
lines.en: A squat shape appears on the slope
I step out from behind a tree
I am one of the smallest elephants.
The ground answers my weight

lines.zh: 海风把我的耳朵吹起来
lines.en: The sea wind lifts my ears
I scent this meadow first
I come down the slope step by step
The ditch here still runs

lines.zh: 我在岛上的旧路上停下
lines.en: I stop on the old island track
Something moves far off
I rumble low

lines.zh: 我的脚印在湿土上很清楚
lines.en: My prints are clear in the wet soil

lines.zh: 火燎到我的耳朵，我猛甩头
lines.en: Fire catches my ear and I shake my head hard

lines.zh: 我从崖边滑下去，侧身撞在坡上
lines.en: I slide off the cliff and hit the slope sideways

lines.zh: 水没过我的鼻子，我抬得老高
lines.en: Water covers my trunk and I raise it high

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推得滑了一段
lines.en: The blast slides me along the ground
An arrow sticks in my shoulder like a thorn

lines.zh: 那股力量压得我腿发虚
lines.en: That force makes my legs give

lines.zh: 这片草被吃光了，我肚子空
lines.en: This meadow is grazed out; my belly's empty

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，我四腿一软
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and my legs buckle
No ground below; I can't move
